calienne_PROMPT_LOADER.SYSTEM: Every execution is assembled from four layers in order: 1. Runtime Prompt (always active). 2. Role Prompt (agent-specific instructions). 3. Conversation Context (history, claims, lessons). 4. Current Task (the immediate user request). Higher layers override lower layers EXCEPT: Runtime rules always remain active and Task never overrides Role.
calienne_PROMPT_LOADER.LAYER_PRECEDENCE: Runtime > Role > Context > Task. Runtime rules are immutable. Task cannot override Role.
